description: Comprehensive Physical Podoben Invocation Concordance for 1761 Pochayiv Menaion — Vol. 9: May (Pochayiv Lavra, 1761)

families.prescribed_model: O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the tribunal
In the Streams of Thy Blood
Having Adorned the Sky with Stars
While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb
Beholding the beauty of thy virginity
Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
In the Spirit in the Sanctuary
What shall we call you, O holy ones
Having laid aside all earthly hope
Having risen on the third day
Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake
